title: Charles & Tena — The Nye Family
description: The story of Charles and Tena Nye and their family, from Sweden and Denmark to Michigan.
intro: Charles Nye married Tena Mortensen in St. Ignace, Michigan, on 5 February 1894. They lived and farmed in Hessel, Michigan, and had eleven children.
charles: Charles was born Karl August Karlsson on 17 October 1864 in Svalnäs, Bo Parish, Örebro County, Sweden.
tena: Tena was born Dorthe Mortensen on 1 December 1873 in Glud Mark, Glud Parish, Vejle County, Denmark.

collection_notes.nojd.homestead.com: The shared family story: Sweden and Denmark, migration, Hessel, the Nye farm, ancestors, cousins, photographs, and records.
collection_notes.karlaugust.homestead.com: Swedish documents and family branches connected to Karl August Karlsson, later Charles Nye.
collection_notes.mortensen.homestead.com: Danish documents and family branches connected to Dorthe Mortensen, later Tena Nye.
